Aaqa Aa Jaiye Shahid Ali Abbas Lyrics
Aaqa Aa Jaiye Maula Aa Jaiye Muntazir Aaj Sara Jahan Hai Aap Aa Jaiye.

1
Janasheen-e-Nabi Aap Ka Hi Yeh Arz-o-Samaa Hai Aap Aa Jaiye.
Kaba Bhi Tera Youn Veeran Hai, Ummat Bhi Sari Pareshan Hai.
Aap Hi Aaein Gay Tu Basay Ga Yeh Sara Jahan Hai Aaqa Aa Jaiye.
Maula Yeh Tere Jo Hubdar Hain, Mushkil Mein Sare Giraftar Hain.

2
Askari Ke Samar Sar Nagoon Aaj Sara Jahan Hai Aaqa Aa Jaiye.
Mana Keh Hum Sab Gunahgar Hain, Mahi Ke Maula Talabgar Hain.
Hum Tere Matami Har Azadar Noha Kuna Hai Aaqa Aa Jaiye.
Mehdi Ko Bhejein Aye Rab-e-Jalil, Aabad Kaba Ko Dekhein Aqeel.

3
Turbat-e-Fatima Ne Pukara Sahib Alzamaan Hai Aaqa Aa Jaiye.
Poete::Aqeel Haider Jafri:
Manqabat Khowan::Shahid Ali Abbas:
Manqabat Volume::Shahid Ali Abbas 2020-21:

from pathlib import Path
p = Path('src/data/lyrics/aaqa-aa-jaiye-shahid-ali-abbas-tajpoints-494159eb68345105949c.md')
_, meta, body = p.read_text().split('---', 2)
roman = meta.split('romanLyrics: |-\\n', 1)[1].split('\\n#', 1)[0]
for lyric, numbers in [(roman, '123'), (body, '۱۲۳')]:
    blocks = lyric.strip().split('\\n\\n')
    assert [len(b.splitlines()) for b in blocks] == [1, 5, 5, 2]
    assert [b.splitlines()[0].strip() for b in blocks[1:]] == list(numbers)
assert '\\u200c' not in body
print('Opening and all nine numbered verses align.')
PY"

item.text:
Reconstructed the Urdu script for “آقا آ جائیے” and retained the Roman wording in `romanLyrics`. The opening and all nine numbered verses align across both versions.

Set the lyric to right-to-left, removed the `noUrdu` tag, and preserved the full poet and reciter credits. The ambiguous Roman reading “Mahi” was rendered as `ماہی`. Only the selected Markdown file was edited.
